passMeaning: PASS means the F0.2b.6 audit dossier is complete and fail-closed. All three assets remain quarantined; bank, Exam/security and content certification remain blocked.

rows.scope: Census, object/passage hashes, directed provenance search, 16-source availability ledger and deny-by-default disposition for exactly three Matching Features assets.
rows.findings: 3/3 assets remain unknown-quarantined. Directed search found no exact passage or named-case match in the reviewed results, but it was non-exhaustive; five visible originality/review claims remain observed and unverified. Four direct fetches returned anti-bot 403/405 and were not reclassified as successful verification.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: Authorship, real/composite/fictional status of named entities, license, rights-holder authorization, factual sign-off and independent human approval remain unresolved; PASS is not clearance.

rows.scope: Executable identity, registry v6, two-pass cardinality, hashes, source binding, leakage controls and stop boundary for the audit-only delta.
rows.findings: 3 passages, 14 visible feature candidates and 19 feature decisions are covered exactly. Registry records fail closed, first-pass decisions are hash-pinned before sources, and seven learner-facing dependencies plus F0.2b.7 remain unchanged.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: Bank and content certification remain blocked. Answer keys are delivered to the client; the runtime locks and corrects on first selection, exposes trap hints before response and cannot represent Practice, Exam or secure assessment.

rows.scope: Clean first-pass association adjudication followed by direct review of 15 candidate factual sources, without showing the stored key before decisions were fixed.
rows.findings: 19/19 independent associations match the stored feature letters, with 0 material ambiguities. All three passage assessments are mixed: relationships are answerable, but visible feature descriptions, ordered structure and weak competition make the construct easier than robust IELTS-style Matching Features.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: Agreement is not approval. The 15 claims received 0 supported, 8 oversimplified, 3 unsupported and 4 untraceable assessments; factual wording, named-entity status, difficulty and cue leakage require editorial repair and fresh blind review.

rows.scope: Prospective blind content-only simulation by an average learner prone to lexical matching, nearby-name selection and overly local reading.
rows.findings: 3/3 passages and 19/19 statements have a walkthrough covering likely misread, association target, evidence search, feature comparison, competitor check, decision rule and repair action without assigning a feature letter.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: This AI walkthrough is not a real-user usability study, accessibility test, retention measure, learning-gain estimate or evidence of IELTS band improvement.

rows.scope: Exhaustive n=19 enumeration of stored labels, set/order sequence, modulo-position, lexical overlap, description length, visible semantic cues, pre-answer traps, representation, prior knowledge and client-key exposure.
rows.findings: Stored counts are A=5, B=3, C=5, D=4, E=2. The question-position modulo feature-count rule scores 11/19; exact label/description overlap scores 1/4 eligible with 15 ties; longest description scores 2/7 eligible with 12 ties. Independent semantic screening found descriptions sufficient for 16/19 and descriptions plus pre-answer traps sufficient for 18/19.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: contentCertification remains blocked: n=19 is below 100, Transport begins A-B-C-D-E, descriptions and traps leak associations, all sets use every feature, keys reach the client and these descriptive diagnostics cannot certify statistical fairness.

rows.scope: Not applicable to conformance for this audit-only delta: seven scoped learner-facing source hashes are pinned unchanged.
rows.findings: The dossier records inherited behavior and accessibility defects but does not modify or approve the DOM, interaction model, responsive shell, visual parity or learning experience.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: This ➖ does not certify the existing UI: 19/19 selects lack accessible names, progress and feedback lack ARIA semantics, focus falls to BODY after lock, English content lacks lang markers, state is not persisted and reset has no confirmation.

rows.scope: Not applicable to learner-runtime certification because F0.2b.6 changes only the audit dossier; existing baseline browser evidence is used solely to describe inherited behavior.
rows.findings: Scoped prior evidence documents route hydration, 19 comboboxes, immediate incorrect feedback/lock, option reuse, 7/7 aggregate completion, reload reset and no overflow at 1280, 390 and 320 pixels.
rows.blockersCarriedForward: No browser matrix was executed as approval of the unchanged learner UI. Portable-report Chromium verification is packaging evidence, not learner-facing Playwright or accessibility certification.
